name: trendpulse
description: TrendPulse — localhost daily trends collector, Jev sorter, Google Sheets store, dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=web"

scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=web
